questions.prompt: How do CAM plants chiefly separate initial carbon fixation from the Calvin cycle, unlike typical C4 plants?

questions.prompt: Ignoring gravity and matrix effects, cell A has solute potential -0.8 MPa and pressure potential +0.3 MPa. Cell B totals -0.7 MPa. In which direction does water initially move across a water-permeable membrane?

choices.text: From B to A, because A has a negative solute potential
Neither way, because both totals are negative
From A to B, because A totals -0.5 MPa
From B to A, because A totals -1.1 MPa

questions.hint: Add each cell's components before comparing the totals.
questions.explanation: Cell A totals -0.5 MPa. Water moves from higher total water potential to lower, so the initial net flow is from A (-0.5) to B (-0.7).

metadata.author: OpenAI
metadata.verificationNotes: Arithmetic verified: -0.8+0.3=-0.5, and -0.5 is higher than -0.7. Prompt explicitly excludes gravity/matrix terms and specifies initial net flow.
